display_long_description:
These 5 tours include 8 to 10 distinct scenes grouped within 2 or 3 specific locations. Tour 1 orients you with a view of the ancient Jerusalem scale model. In Tour 2, visit sites next to the western and southern walls near the temple mount. Tour 3 opens with a panoramic view of the city from the Mount of Olives, moves to the Garden of Gethsemane, then inside the City of David stopping at an ancient retaining wall, the exit from Hezekiah’s Tunnel and ends at the Pool of Siloam. Tour 4 focuses on Jesus’ northern Galilee ministry at Capernaum and Chorazin. In Tour 5 of the Sea of Galilee, you’ll move around the shoreline stopping at 8 viewpoints, including Tiberias, Magdala, and where the Jordan River enters and exits the sea.
Every 360 image and audio script was carefully researched and designed. Guided by our expert audio, look all around, scanning above and below, to get acquainted with differing facets of each biblical site. If planning a trip there, our VRBX 360 tours offer an impressive and immersive preparation before your visit to appreciate more fully each location. These virtual tours are convenient and easily accessible—you can return to each tour as often as you wish—they’re always available.
